additional_verification_state.NOT VERIFIED: Used where evidence/capability has not actually been verified, including current calibration/accuracy values and hardware readiness. It is not a quality_status enum value in the frozen observation schema.

states.RAW: Original/raw observation state before QA promotion.
states.CAPTURED: Observation captured/registered but not yet fully validated.
states.VALIDATED: Observation passed the applicable validation/QA checks.
states.UNCERTAIN: Observation is retained but has unresolved uncertainty, such as unavailable GNSS position; it must not be promoted as fully validated.
states.REJECTED: Observation failed a required validation rule and must not be promoted to the canonical record.
states.NOT VERIFIED: Evidence or capability has not been verified; do not manufacture confidence.
